STATE
WORKING:
- globalThis fix applied to ws-server.ts, store.ts, approval-queue.ts — all server singletons shared correctly across Next.js module instances
- Real Claude Code sessions appear as workers, animate, show correct tool names from stdin JSON
- Demo mode works end-to-end: worker walks in, reads, types, gets approval toast for git push, walks out
- Worker click popup: shows name, state, cwd, recent 5 tool calls, session duration, Focus Terminal button
- Hook scripts read stdin JSON correctly (not env vars)
- No-browser fallthrough: if no WS clients, returns 204 so Claude Code handles approval normally in terminal
- No timeout on approvals — waits forever when browser is open
- Stale sessions cleaned up via SessionEnd hooks (not time-based — time-based was evicting active sessions)
- shfmt AST-based bash command parsing in tool-classifier prevents false positives on strings containing risky keywords
- Workers named: Pixel, Byte, Cache, Queue, Stack (matched in WorkerPanel; WorkerPopup may still have old Alice/Bob names)

BROKEN:
- Auto-approve returns {} instead of explicit allow → Claude Code still prompts in terminal
- iTerm2 focus opens app but doesn't switch to correct tab — tty injected via hook but matching may fail in subprocess

NEXT:
1. Fix pre-tool-use auto-approve to return explicit permissionDecision:allow
